status: Proposed fresh manual construction sections inferred from one perspective target; not recovered 3D truth.

unitsAndAxes.authoringAxes: Blender X right, Y depth, Z up
unitsAndAxes.sectionAxes: All values are full diameters. Trunk uses [X width, Y depth]. Branch/root uses [U width, V thickness] in a local tangent frame.
unitsAndAxes.tangentRule: Endpoint tangent uses its adjacent segment. Interior tangent is normalize(nextPoint - previousPoint).
unitsAndAxes.branchRootOrientationRule: Let H be normalized XY projection of tangent; U=normalize(cross([0,0,1],H)); V=normalize(cross(tangent,U)). Carry forward U only if H is degenerate. Keep U/V continuous between sections; do not reset to world axes.
unitsAndAxes.trunkOrientationRule: Loft trunk ellipses near-horizontal; cumulative Z rotations at T0–T4 are [0,8,17,27,35] degrees. Do not substitute section rotation for the leader return.
unitsAndAxes.calculationRule: Segment length is Euclidean distance. Intersegment bend is acos(dot(normalized adjacent segments)) in degrees, rounded to 0.1.

contract.geometryMethod: Fresh connected lofts and bridged sections only; no held candidate or Trial A geometry reuse.

trunk.attachmentContinuity: Root sections bridge into T0/T1 collar faces. Right branch shares split-ring T3. Left branch and upper leader share split-ring T4.
visibleCurveChecks: T0→T3 is the restrained lower rightward sweep.
T3→T4 begins the return; leader continues it visibly under the high lobe.
Source-facing outer contours must show the sequence, not merely an offset centerline.

majorBranches.sharedAttachment: Split/bridge from T4; L0 matches T4 collar dimensions before tapering.
majorBranches.sourceFacingCheck: L0→L2 shallow up-left departure, then L2→L4 upward elbow remains visible under left lobe; a straight diagonal fails.

majorBranches.sharedAttachment: Split/bridge from T3; R0 matches T3 collar dimensions before tapering.
majorBranches.sourceFacingCheck: R0→R2 forms lower lateral counterweight; R2→R4 turns upward under right lobe. A mirrored left limb or one-segment rod fails.

majorBranches.sharedAttachment: Split/bridge from T4; U0 matches T4 collar dimensions before tapering.
majorBranches.sourceFacingCheck: U0→U2 follows lower rightward sweep; U2→U4 visibly returns left toward high-lobe support. A monotonic +X leader fails.

roots.sharedAttachment: Bridge to left-front T0/T1 collar face; no separate wedge.
roots.sourceFacingCheck: Visible left toe turns outward/down from collar and remains broad; straight fin fails.

roots.sharedAttachment: Bridge to right-front T0/T1 collar face; largest readable source-facing toe.
roots.sourceFacingCheck: Widest front toe turns forward/outward at FR2→FR3; radial straight wedge fails.

roots.sharedAttachment: Bridge to rear-left T0/T1 collar face; rear stabilizer.
roots.sourceFacingCheck: Rear/left view proves grounded counter-root and shallow collar valley.

roots.sharedAttachment: Bridge to rear-right T0/T1 collar face; rear counterbalance.
roots.sourceFacingCheck: Rear/right view proves rounded counter-root, not copied front fin.

roots.sharedAttachment: Bridge to rear T0/T1 collar face and close valley at trunk/ground; no tunnel.
roots.sourceFacingCheck: Rear view proves fifth grounded root without source-facing toe fan.

aggregateChecks.attachmentRule: At named shared attachments, split/bridge parent loft faces. Match attachment center and parent section dimensions before tapering; no rods, detached wedges, or Boolean gaps.
preflightFailureConditions: Any major limb reads as chord from first to last point in source-facing review.
Leader continues monotonically right instead of returning from U2 through U4.
Root reads as razor fin/radial fan or leaves tunnel-like collar gap.
All-angle mesh cannot show five distinct grounded closed buttresses and supported branch junctions.
